findings: Runtime adapter remains a thin boundary: parse DTO JSON, call existing suite domain/app functions, serialize accepted/error responses.
No storage, Workflow execution, OpenTofu execution, incident rollback execution, child service call, cloud I/O, or audit emitter was added.
Uses the repo-native Hyper/router/middleware seam and mirrors HR/payroll/accounting runtime adapter patterns for consistency.

findings: Invalid JSON and invalid suite commands return validation envelopes instead of panicking.

findings.summary: Route dispatch is bounded by shared router matching and fixed-size JSON payload handling; no I/O loops, storage calls, child-service calls, Workflow execution, or OpenTofu execution are introduced.

findings: Public runtime response and route-manifest fields carry data_class annotations.

Health response explicitly marks deployed listener, auth runtime, storage, Workflow execution, OpenTofu execution, incident rollback execution, child-service calls, cloud integration, and runtime audit emission false.
The change is additive: one Enterprise Suite runtime crate, catalog row, workspace membership, spec/tasks/evidence updates, and no migrations or external resources.
Route manifest names operation IDs and data-class classifications for future telemetry labels.
Health response exposes router-ready status and non-claim booleans without runtime emission claims.
Enterprise Suite AC-09 and D-06 record the runtime adapter foundation and keep listener/auth/storage/Workflow/OpenTofu/incident/child-service/cloud/SLO as future slices.

M1_challenge_assumption.premise_stated: An Enterprise Suite HTTP runtime foundation can land before cloud integration if it stays router-only and does not claim deployed suite runtime, storage, Workflow, incident rollback, OpenTofu, or cloud execution.
M1_challenge_assumption.premise_evidence_ref: specs/microservices/enterprise-suite.json AC-09 and runtime health non-claim tests
M1_challenge_assumption.do_nothing_consequence: Enterprise Suite would keep DTO/OpenAPI contracts but lack executable route bindings for later runtime/server mounting.
M1_challenge_assumption.upstream_fix_rejection_reason: Shared Hyper foundation already exists; the missing seam is enterprise-suite-specific route binding.

findings: This completes first-pass router-ready runtime foundations for HR, Payroll, Accounting, and Enterprise Suite while preserving honest non-claims.
Names follow Enterprise Suite policy admission, group rollup, cross-product Workflow, incident rollback, ops command, runtime adapter, route manifest, and OpenAPI operation vocabulary.
Enterprise Suite spec, OpenAPI meta, plan, todo, evidence, catalog, and audit-chain references were updated.
Runtime-specific code lives in a new Enterprise Suite runtime crate; API DTOs and app/domain crates remain unchanged.
No new HTTP framework, auth middleware, storage repository, Workflow client, OpenTofu executor, incident rollback executor, child-service client, cloud adapter, or audit emitter was introduced.

No new third-party dependencies were added; runtime uses existing workspace serde/serde_json and repo-native HTTP foundation crates, and dependency-rationales allow-list was updated for adapter-layer use.
Responses use camelCase JSON and align to existing EnterpriseSuiteAccepted OpenAPI shape; OpenAPI metadata records the runtime adapter addition.
Handlers perform deterministic parse -> domain/app call -> JSON response flow with explicit 400/202/200 status mapping.
